sources.title: Models - UkisAI
sources.snippet: Swift 1.5 Qwen3.8-27B is UkisAI's reasoning-efficient derivative of Qwen3.8-27B. It uses 58.5% fewer thinking tokens while scoring 0.35% higher than the base, for a 9.18× speed-up on several tasks.
